responsibility: Central prototype header for the LoongArch backend implementation. It declares the symbol-classification enum for LoongArch addressing and TLS forms, and the public functions implemented mainly in loongarch.cc and loongarch-builtins.cc covering address legitimacy, move expansion, prologue/epilogue generation, block moves, branch expansion, atomic helpers, builtin initialization/expansion, scheduling helpers, section/output routines, and other target hooks referenced across the backend.
